```{r nicotine_legacy_experimental_comparisons, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
make_experimental_delta_curve <- function(mean_data, nic_data,
                                          method_label,
                                          y_label,
                                          title_suffix) {
  light_d <- mean_data %>% dplyr::filter(Condition == "rubi_light")
  no_light_d <- mean_data %>% dplyr::filter(Condition == "rubi_no_light")
  start_time <- max(min(light_d$TimeRubi), min(no_light_d$TimeRubi))
  end_time <- min(max(light_d$TimeRubi), max(no_light_d$TimeRubi))
  dt <- median(c(diff(light_d$TimeRubi), diff(no_light_d$TimeRubi)), na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.finite(dt) || dt <= 0 || end_time <= start_time) return(NULL)

  grid <- seq(start_time, end_time, by = dt)
  delta_d <- make_independent_mean_delta(light_d, no_light_d, grid)
  nic_d <- nic_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(TimeRubi >= start_time, TimeRubi <= end_time) %>%
    dplyr::select(TimeRubi, Mean, CI_low, CI_high, N, Condition)

  comparison_d <- dplyr::bind_rows(delta_d, nic_d) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Method = method_label)

  p <- ggplot(comparison_d, aes(TimeRubi, Mean, color = Condition)) +
    light_band_layer() +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey75", linewidth = 0.45) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = exp_light_window[1], linetype = "dashed", color = "grey45") +
    geom_ribbon(
      aes(ymin = CI_low, ymax = CI_high, fill = Condition),
      alpha = 0.13,
      color = NA
    ) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.25) +
    condition_color_scale(breaks = c("nic mean", "rubi_light - rubi_no_light")) +
    condition_fill_scale(breaks = c("nic mean", "rubi_light - rubi_no_light")) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Nicotine і Δ RuBi-Nicotine: ", title_suffix),
      subtitle = paste0("Nicotine: підйом на ", exp_light_window[1],
                        " с; Δ = опромінений - неопромінений"),
      x = "Час від початку відповіді, с",
      y = y_label
    ) +
    presentation_theme() +
    axes_from_origin(comparison_d, "TimeRubi")

  list(data = comparison_d, plot = p)
}

summarise_metric_ci <- function(d) {
  d %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Condition, Metric) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      Mean = mean(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
      SD = stats::sd(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
      N = sum(is.finite(Value)),
      SEM = SD / sqrt(N),
      CI_low = Mean - stats::qt(0.975, pmax(N - 1, 1)) * SEM,
      CI_high = Mean + stats::qt(0.975, pmax(N - 1, 1)) * SEM,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      CI_low = ifelse(N < 2, NA_real_, CI_low),
      CI_high = ifelse(N < 2, NA_real_, CI_high)
    )
}

nic_light_effect_metrics <- nic_light_effect_experimental %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    Condition, Curve, Sample, PreLightLevel, Y420,
    DeltaMax420_540, AUC420_540FromY420, Slope420_540
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(DeltaMax420_540, AUC420_540FromY420, Slope420_540),
    names_to = "Metric",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Metric = dplyr::recode(
      Metric,
      DeltaMax420_540 = "Приріст max - y420",
      AUC420_540FromY420 = "AUC 420-540 від y420",
      Slope420_540 = "Нахил 420-540"
    )
  )

rubi_metric_summary <- summarise_metric_ci(rubi_light_effect_metrics)
nic_metric_summary <- summarise_metric_ci(nic_light_effect_metrics)
experimental_delta_metric_summary <- rubi_metric_summary %>%
  dplyr::select(Condition, Metric, Mean, SEM, N) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Condition,
    values_from = c(Mean, SEM, N)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    Condition = "rubi_light - rubi_no_light",
    Metric,
    Mean = Mean_rubi_light - Mean_rubi_no_light,
    SEM = sqrt(SEM_rubi_light^2 + SEM_rubi_no_light^2),
    N_light = N_rubi_light,
    N_no_light = N_rubi_no_light,
    CI_low = Mean - stats::qt(
      0.975,
      pmin(pmax(N_light - 1, 1), pmax(N_no_light - 1, 1))
    ) * SEM,
    CI_high = Mean + stats::qt(
      0.975,
      pmin(pmax(N_light - 1, 1), pmax(N_no_light - 1, 1))
    ) * SEM
  )

experimental_delta_nic_metrics <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  experimental_delta_metric_summary,
  nic_metric_summary %>%
    dplyr::select(Condition, Metric, Mean, SEM, N, CI_low, CI_high)
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Method = "Метрики у зоні 420-540 с")

    )
  ) +
  labs(

    subtitle = paste0(
      "Вікно ", exp_light_window[1], "-", exp_light_window[2],

    ),

  ) +
```

### Основний експериментальний варіант: нормування на y420

```{r nicotine_y420_comparison, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
# Для кожної окремої RuBi-кривої: y_norm(t) = y(t) / y(420) - 1.
# Тому обидві групи дорівнюють нулю в 420 с, а Δ є різницею вже
# нормованих групових середніх і не нормується повторно.

make_y420_scaled_mean <- function(d, condition_key,
                                  value_col = "TraceNormKCl0",
                                  y420_min_abs = 0.05) {
  scaled_d <- d %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Curve) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Y420Scale = curve_value_at(TimeRubi, .data[[value_col]], exp_light_window[1]),
      TraceY420Relative = ifelse(
        is.finite(Y420Scale) & abs(Y420Scale) >= y420_min_abs,
        .data[[value_col]] / Y420Scale - 1,
        NA_real_
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()
  scaled_d$Condition <- condition_key
  valid_curves <- scaled_d %>%
    dplyr::distinct(Curve, Y420Scale) %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.finite(Y420Scale), abs(Y420Scale) >= y420_min_abs) %>%
    dplyr::pull(Curve)
  if (!length(valid_curves)) {
    stop("Немає кривих із придатним y420 для ", condition_key, ".")
  }
  mean_d <- dplyr::filter(scaled_d, Curve %in% valid_curves)

  m <- make_mean_curve(
    split(mean_d, mean_d$Curve),
    time_col = "TimeRubi",
    value_col = "TraceY420Relative",
    target_end_time = rubi_light_duration
  )
  m$Condition <- condition_key

  list(data = scaled_d, mean = m, valid_curves = valid_curves)
}

)

) %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.finite(TraceY420Relative)) %>%
```

```{r same_list_rubi_pair_experimental, fig.width=11, fig.height=6}
make_same_list_y420_delta <- function(d) {
  light_d <- dplyr::filter(d, Condition == "rubi_light")
  no_light_d <- dplyr::filter(d, Condition == "rubi_no_light")
  start_time <- max(min(light_d$TimeRubi), min(no_light_d$TimeRubi))
  end_time <- min(max(light_d$TimeRubi), max(no_light_d$TimeRubi))
  dt <- median(c(diff(light_d$TimeRubi), diff(no_light_d$TimeRubi)), na.rm = TRUE)
  grid <- seq(start_time, end_time, by = dt)

  data.frame(
    Pair = d$Pair[1],
    TimeRubi = grid,
    Delta = approx(
      light_d$TimeRubi, light_d$TraceY420Relative,
      xout = grid, rule = 1, ties = mean
    )$y - approx(
      no_light_d$TimeRubi, no_light_d$TraceY420Relative,
      xout = grid, rule = 1, ties = mean
    )$y
  )
}
```

### Exploratory-відбір кривих із горбом у 420-540 с

```{r rubi_y420_clear_hump_experimental, fig.width=11, fig.height=6}
# Офіційний режим 3 (exploratory): опромінені записи з виразним горбом
# у зоні світла. Неопромінені контролі не відбираємо за формою кривої.
summarise_light_hump <- function(d, light_window = c(420, 540),
                                 end_window = c(525, 540),
                                 smooth_seconds = 8,
                                 min_rise = 0.10,
                                 min_drop = 0.05,
                                 min_drop_fraction = 0.15) {
  d <- d[is.finite(d$TimeRubi) & is.finite(d$TraceY420Relative), ]
  d <- d[order(d$TimeRubi), ]
  if (nrow(d) < 15) return(NULL)

  dt <- median(diff(d$TimeRubi), na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.finite(dt) || dt <= 0) dt <- 1
  k <- max(3, as.integer(round(smooth_seconds / dt)))
  if (k %% 2 == 0) k <- k + 1
  max_k <- if (nrow(d) %% 2 == 1) nrow(d) else nrow(d) - 1
  k <- min(k, max_k)
  smooth_y <- stats::runmed(d$TraceY420Relative, k = k, endrule = "median")

  in_light <- d$TimeRubi >= light_window[1] & d$TimeRubi <= light_window[2]
  at_end <- d$TimeRubi >= end_window[1] & d$TimeRubi <= end_window[2]
  pre_light <- d$TimeRubi >= light_window[1] - 60 & d$TimeRubi < light_window[1]
  if (sum(in_light) < 5 || sum(at_end) < 3) return(NULL)

  light_idx <- which(in_light)
  peak_idx <- light_idx[which.max(smooth_y[light_idx])]
  y_start <- curve_value_at(d$TimeRubi, smooth_y, light_window[1])
  y_end <- median(smooth_y[at_end], na.rm = TRUE)
  peak_value <- smooth_y[peak_idx]
  rise <- peak_value - y_start
  drop <- peak_value - y_end
  noise <- stats::mad(
    d$TraceY420Relative[pre_light] - smooth_y[pre_light],
    constant = 1.4826,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  if (!is.finite(noise)) noise <- 0

  rise_threshold <- max(min_rise, 4 * noise)
  drop_threshold <- max(min_drop, 3 * noise, min_drop_fraction * rise)
  interior_peak <- d$TimeRubi[peak_idx] >= light_window[1] + 5 &
    d$TimeRubi[peak_idx] <= light_window[2] - 5

  data.frame(
    Curve = d$Curve[1],
    Sample = d$Sample[1],
    SeriesList = d$SeriesList[1],
    PeakTime = d$TimeRubi[peak_idx],
    PeakFromY420 = rise,
    DropBy540 = drop,
    NoiseMAD = noise,
    RiseThreshold = rise_threshold,
    DropThreshold = drop_threshold,
    ClearHump = interior_peak & rise >= rise_threshold & drop >= drop_threshold
  )
}

)) %>%

  hump_dt <- median(c(

      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 1.3
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "Опромінений RuBi-Nicotine: записи з горбом у 420-540 с",
      subtitle = paste0(
        "n = ", n_hump,
        "; горб: внутрішній максимум, приріст >= max(0.10; 4xMAD), ",
        "спад до 540 с >= max(0.05; 3xMAD; 15% приросту)"
      ),
      x = "Час від початку відповіді, с",
      y = "Відносна зміна від y420"
    ) +
    presentation_theme() +
    axes_from_origin(rubi_light_clear_hump_y420, "TimeRubi")

  p_rubi_clear_hump_means <- ggplot(
    rubi_clear_hump_y420_means,
    aes(TimeRubi, Mean, color = Condition, fill = Condition)
  ) +
    light_band_layer() +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey75", linewidth = 0.45) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 420, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey45") +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = CI_low, ymax = CI_high), alpha = 0.13, color = NA) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.25) +
```

## 9. Фармакологічні групи

```{r selected_groups_norm_by_kcl, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
if (!exists("rubi_light_mean")) {
  stop("Спочатку виконайте chunk rubi_light_norm_by_kcl, щоб був об'єкт rubi_light_mean.")
}

condition_keys <- c("caps", "amg", "cgrp", "l703606", "cgrp_l703606")
condition_exclude <- list()
condition_results <- list()

for (condition_key in condition_keys) {
  exclude <- condition_exclude[[condition_key]]
  if (is.null(exclude)) exclude <- character()

  res <- normalize_condition_by_kcl(
    series_defs = series_defs,
    condition_key = condition_key,
    marker_range = marker_range,
    exclude = exclude
  )
  if (is.null(res)) next

  condition_results[[condition_key]] <- res
  assign(paste0(condition_key, "_norm"), res$data, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  assign(paste0(condition_key, "_curve_summary"), res$summary, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  assign(paste0(condition_key, "_mean"), res$mean, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  assign(paste0(condition_key, "_alignment_summary"), res$alignment, envir = .GlobalEnv)

  print(utils::head(res$summary, 10))
  print(res$alignment)
  condition_title <- condition_label(condition_key)

  res_plot_data <- thin_plot_data(
    res$data,
    group_col = "Curve",
    max_points = 4000
  )
  p_curves <- ggplot(res_plot_data, aes(TimeRubi, TraceNormKCl0, group = Curve)) +
    light_band_layer() +
    geom_line(alpha = 0.35, linewidth = 0.55, color = condition_color(condition_key)) +
    geom_ribbon(
      data = res$mean,
      aes(TimeRubi, ymin = CI_low, ymax = CI_high),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      fill = "grey35",
      alpha = 0.18
    ) +
    geom_line(data = res$mean, aes(TimeRubi, Mean),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, color = "black", linewidth = 1.25) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(condition_title, ", нормовано на амплітуду KCl"),
      subtitle = paste("n =", dplyr::n_distinct(res$data$Curve), "кривих"),
      x = "Час від початку відповіді, с",
      y = "Нормована відповідь"
    ) +
    presentation_theme() +
    axes_from_origin(res$data, "TimeRubi")

  mean_compare <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    dplyr::mutate(rubi_light_mean, Condition = "rubi_light"),
    dplyr::mutate(res$mean, Condition = condition_key)
  )
  mean_compare_plot <- if (identical(condition_key, "cgrp_l703606")) {
    crop_to_shortest_curve(mean_compare)
  } else {
    mean_compare
  }

  p_mean_compare <- ggplot(mean_compare_plot, aes(TimeRubi, Mean, color = Condition)) +
    light_band_layer() +
    geom_ribbon(
      aes(ymin = CI_low, ymax = CI_high, fill = Condition),
      alpha = 0.16,
      color = NA
    ) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.25) +
    condition_color_scale(breaks = c(condition_key, "rubi_light")) +
    condition_fill_scale(breaks = c(condition_key, "rubi_light")) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(
        "Середні криві\n", condition_title,
        " і опромінений RuBi-Nicotine"
      ),
      x = "Час від початку відповіді, с",
      y = "Середня нормована відповідь"
    ) +
    presentation_theme() +
    axes_from_origin(mean_compare_plot, "TimeRubi")

  show_plot(p_curves)
  show_plot(p_mean_compare)
  save_group_plot(
    p_curves, condition_key,
    paste0(condition_key, "_individual_curves_and_mean")
  )
  save_group_plot(
    p_mean_compare, condition_key,
    paste0(condition_key, "_mean_vs_rubi_light")
  )
}
```

## 10. Експорт результатів

```{r export_mean_curves_to_data}
# Експорт не перераховує дані: він записує вже створені вище об'єкти *_mean
# та таблиці порівнянь у таку саму структуру підпапок, як і рисунки.
mean_curve_export_root <- "./data/mean_curves/2025"

save_mean_curve_csv <- function(data, group, filename,
                                root = mean_curve_export_root) {
  if (is.null(data) || !is.data.frame(data) || !nrow(data)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  output_dir <- file.path(root, group)
  dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  if (!grepl("\\.csv$", filename, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    filename <- paste0(filename, ".csv")
  }

  path <- file.path(output_dir, filename)
  utils::write.csv(data, path, row.names = FALSE)
  data.frame(Group = group, File = path, Rows = nrow(data))
}

save_mean_curve_object <- function(object_name, group, filename = object_name,
                                   envir = .GlobalEnv) {
  if (!exists(object_name, envir = envir)) return(NULL)
  save_mean_curve_csv(get(object_name, envir = envir), group, filename)
}

mean_curve_exports <- list()
add_mean_export <- function(x) {
  if (!is.null(x)) mean_curve_exports[[length(mean_curve_exports) + 1]] <<- x
}

for (cfg in simple_mean_exports) {

  list("all_means_without_no_light", "all_groups", "all_mean_curves"),
  list("all_means_plot", "all_groups", "all_mean_curves_cropped_to_shortest"),
  list("glutathione_vs_rubi_no_light", "glutathione", "glutathione_vs_rubi_no_light_mean"),
  list("h2o2_means", "h2o2", "all_h2o2_mean_curves"),
  list("rubi_no_vs_h2o2", "h2o2", "rubi_no_light_glutathione_and_h2o2_mean"),
  list("rubi_no_vs_h2o2_display", "h2o2", "rubi_no_light_glutathione_and_h2o2_display_mean"),
  list("rubi_no_vs_h2o2_kinetics", "h2o2", "rubi_no_light_vs_h2o2_1000_kinetics"),
  list("rubi_no_vs_h2o2_kinetics_display", "h2o2", "rubi_no_light_vs_h2o2_1000_kinetics_display")
)

for (cfg in combined_mean_exports) {
  add_mean_export(save_mean_curve_object(cfg[[1]], cfg[[2]], cfg[[3]]))
}

# Середні по ділянках препарату.
add_mean_export(save_mean_curve_object(
  "rubi_light_region_means",
  "rubi_light/regions",
  "rubi_light_by_drug_region_mean"
))
add_mean_export(save_mean_curve_object(
  "rubi_no_light_region_means",
  "rubi_no_light/regions",
  "rubi_no_light_by_drug_region_mean"
))

# Середні по кластеризації у зоні опромінення 420-540 с.
if (exists("rubi_light_window_clusters") &&
    !is.null(rubi_light_window_clusters$mean)) {
  add_mean_export(save_mean_curve_csv(
    rubi_light_window_clusters$mean,
    "rubi_comparison/window_420_540",
    "rubi_light_clusters_by_420_540_window_mean"
  ))
}
if (exists("rubi_no_light_window_clusters") &&
    !is.null(rubi_no_light_window_clusters$mean)) {
  add_mean_export(save_mean_curve_csv(
    rubi_no_light_window_clusters$mean,
    "rubi_comparison/window_420_540",
    "rubi_no_light_clusters_by_420_540_window_mean"
  ))
}
if (exists("paired_delta_window_clusters") &&
    !is.null(paired_delta_window_clusters$mean)) {
  add_mean_export(save_mean_curve_csv(
    paired_delta_window_clusters$mean,
    "rubi_comparison/window_420_540",
    "paired_delta_clusters_by_420_540_window_mean"
  ))
}

mean_curve_export_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(mean_curve_exports)
print(mean_curve_export_summary)
```
